claim: A checked bag on a Meridian Economy fare can weigh up to 23 kg.
stale: Meridian Economy fares include one checked bag of up to 20 kg.
current: Meridian Economy fares include one checked bag of up to 23 kg.

claim: Meridian Wallet refunds reach the customer within five working days.
stale: Refunds to a Meridian Wallet are processed within 10 working days.
current: Refunds to a Meridian Wallet are processed within 5 working days.

claim: Altering a Flex fare booking costs GBP 25 for each passenger.
stale: Changing a Meridian Flex fare booking costs GBP 40 per passenger.
current: Changing a Meridian Flex fare booking costs GBP 25 per passenger.

claim: Cover Plus reimburses lost baggage up to GBP 2,000.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus pays up to GBP 1,500 for lost baggage.
current: Meridian Cover Plus pays up to GBP 2,000 for lost baggage.

claim: To reserve an excursion, a guest pays a deposit equal to 30% of its price.
stale: Excursion deposits are 20% of the excursion price.
current: Excursion deposits are 30% of the excursion price.

claim: Customer relations answers a complaint in writing within 14 days.
stale: Meridian's customer relations team sends a full written reply to a complaint within 28 days.
current: Meridian's customer relations team sends a full written reply to a complaint within 14 days.

claim: Customers can hold a package booking for 72 hours before paying.
stale: A Meridian package booking can be held without payment for 48 hours.
current: A Meridian package booking can be held without payment for 72 hours.

claim: Meridian charter flights accept cabin bags measuring up to 56 x 45 x 25 cm.
stale: Cabin bags on Meridian charter flights must fit within 55 x 40 x 20 cm. Bags that exceed the limit are moved to the hold at the gate. The gate fee is GBP 35.
current: Cabin bags on Meridian charter flights must fit within 56 x 45 x 25 cm. Bags that exceed the limit are moved to the hold at the gate. The gate fee is GBP 35.

claim: An unused airport transfer is refunded at 60% of what was paid for it.
stale: Meridian refunds unused airport transfers on request. The refund is 80% of the transfer price. Requests must be made through the booking portal.
current: Meridian refunds unused airport transfers on request. The refund is 60% of the transfer price. Requests must be made through the booking portal.

claim: The excess on a medical cancellation claim under Cover Plus is GBP 150 for each person.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus includes cancellation cover for medical reasons. The excess is GBP 75 per person. Claims need a doctor's certificate.
current: Meridian Cover Plus includes cancellation cover for medical reasons. The excess is GBP 150 per person. Claims need a doctor's certificate.

claim: Meridian's visa assistance service costs GBP 65 for every applicant.
stale: Meridian's visa assistance service submits applications to the embassy on the customer's behalf. The service fee is GBP 49 per applicant. Embassy fees are charged separately.
current: Meridian's visa assistance service submits applications to the embassy on the customer's behalf. The service fee is GBP 65 per applicant. Embassy fees are charged separately.

claim: No more than 18 guests are placed with one excursion guide.
stale: Meridian excursion guides lead groups of at most 25 guests. Each guide carries a first-aid kit. Guests must check in 15 minutes before departure.
current: Meridian excursion guides lead groups of at most 18 guests. Each guide carries a first-aid kit. Guests must check in 15 minutes before departure.

claim: Partner miles earned on Northwind Air flights through Meridian lapse after 24 months.
stale: Meridian earns partner miles on flights with Northwind Air at a rate of 1 mile per GBP 2 spent. Miles are credited within 6 weeks. Miles expire after 36 months.
current: Meridian earns partner miles on flights with Northwind Air at a rate of 1 mile per GBP 2 spent. Miles are credited within 6 weeks. Miles expire after 24 months.

claim: Picking a seat on a Saver fare costs GBP 15 for each flight.
stale: Meridian Saver fares allow seat selection for a fee of GBP 12 per flight. Selection opens at booking. Seats in the exit row cost extra.
current: Meridian Saver fares allow seat selection for a fee of GBP 15 per flight. Selection opens at booking. Seats in the exit row cost extra.

claim: An upheld complaint can earn a goodwill payment of up to 15% of the package price.
stale: Complaints about a package holiday can be raised with the resort representative. A written complaint must include the booking reference. Meridian offers a goodwill payment of up to 10% of the package price for upheld complaints.
current: Complaints about a package holiday can be raised with the resort representative. A written complaint must include the booking reference. Meridian offers a goodwill payment of up to 15% of the package price for upheld complaints.

claim: Each sports item on a scheduled flight costs GBP 55 each way.
stale: Meridian allows sports equipment as checked baggage on scheduled flights. Equipment must be packed in a protective case. Golf bags are accepted on all routes. A sports equipment fee of GBP 45 each way applies per item. Items over 32 kg are not accepted.
current: Meridian allows sports equipment as checked baggage on scheduled flights. Equipment must be packed in a protective case. Golf bags are accepted on all routes. A sports equipment fee of GBP 55 each way applies per item. Items over 32 kg are not accepted.

claim: Canceling a package more than 70 days ahead of departure costs 20% of the package price.
stale: Customers who cancel a package holiday receive a refund minus the cancellation charge. The charge depends on the number of days before departure. Insurance premiums are not refundable. Refunds are paid to the original payment method. Cancellations made more than 70 days before departure incur a charge of 15% of the package price. Customers receive written confirmation of the amount.
current: Customers who cancel a package holiday receive a refund minus the cancellation charge. The charge depends on the number of days before departure. Insurance premiums are not refundable. Refunds are paid to the original payment method. Cancellations made more than 70 days before departure incur a charge of 20% of the package price. Customers receive written confirmation of the amount.

claim: Overseas emergency medical costs are covered up to GBP 5 million per person.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus is sold with every package holiday. The policy covers emergency medical costs abroad up to GBP 2 million per person. Cover applies from the day of departure. Pre-existing conditions must be declared at purchase. A 24-hour assistance line is included.
current: Meridian Cover Plus is sold with every package holiday. The policy covers emergency medical costs abroad up to GBP 5 million per person. Cover applies from the day of departure. Pre-existing conditions must be declared at purchase. A 24-hour assistance line is included.

claim: A passport used for a long-haul Meridian trip needs three months of validity on the arrival day.
stale: Customers are responsible for holding valid entry documents. Meridian checks passport validity at booking. Passports must have at least 6 months' validity on the day of arrival for long-haul destinations. Customers who are refused boarding due to invalid documents receive no refund. Meridian's visa desk can advise on requirements.
current: Customers are responsible for holding valid entry documents. Meridian checks passport validity at booking. Passports must have at least 3 months' validity on the day of arrival for long-haul destinations. Customers who are refused boarding due to invalid documents receive no refund. Meridian's visa desk can advise on requirements.

claim: A group excursion goes ahead once six guests have booked.
stale: Meridian excursions are operated by vetted local partners. Each excursion page lists the activity level and the minimum age. A group excursion runs only if at least 8 guests have booked. Excursion tickets are emailed to the lead passenger. Guests with mobility needs should contact the resort team.
current: Meridian excursions are operated by vetted local partners. Each excursion page lists the activity level and the minimum age. A group excursion runs only if at least 6 guests have booked. Excursion tickets are emailed to the lead passenger. Guests with mobility needs should contact the resort team.

claim: Children up to age 13 pay the child price on Meridian Sun packages.
stale: Children under 12 pay the child price on Meridian Sun packages.
current: Children under 14 pay the child price on Meridian Sun packages.

claim: Eight travelers are enough to use Meridian's group booking desk.
stale: Groups of 10 or more passengers qualify for Meridian's group booking desk.
current: Groups of 8 or more passengers qualify for Meridian's group booking desk.

claim: A 14-year-old can fly with Meridian without an adult traveling alongside.
stale: Passengers aged under 16 must be accompanied by an adult on Meridian flights.
current: Passengers aged under 14 must be accompanied by an adult on Meridian flights.

claim: Free changes to a Flex fare are possible until 7 days ahead of departure.
stale: Meridian Flex fares can be changed free of charge up to 14 days before departure.
current: Meridian Flex fares can be changed free of charge up to 7 days before departure.

claim: Four qualifying flights in a calendar year earn Meridian Gold status.
stale: Meridian Gold status requires 6 qualifying flights in a calendar year.
current: Meridian Gold status requires 4 qualifying flights in a calendar year.

claim: A traveler of 60 qualifies for the Meridian senior discount.
stale: Seniors aged 65 and over receive the Meridian senior discount.
current: Seniors aged 60 and over receive the Meridian senior discount.

claim: Bookings of three nights qualify for the late-checkout waiver.
stale: Meridian's late-checkout waiver applies to bookings of 5 nights or more.
current: Meridian's late-checkout waiver applies to bookings of 3 nights or more.

claim: A pregnant traveler at 30 weeks does not need a medical certificate to fly with Meridian.
stale: Meridian requires a medical certificate for passengers beyond 28 weeks of pregnancy. The certificate must be dated within 10 days of travel. Airlines may refuse boarding without it.
current: Meridian requires a medical certificate for passengers beyond 32 weeks of pregnancy. The certificate must be dated within 10 days of travel. Airlines may refuse boarding without it.

claim: Medical screening is mandatory for travel insurance buyers aged 75 or more.
stale: Travel insurance medical screening is required for travelers aged 70 and over. Screening takes about ten minutes by phone. A surcharge may apply after screening.
current: Travel insurance medical screening is required for travelers aged 75 and over. Screening takes about ten minutes by phone. A surcharge may apply after screening.

claim: Nine travelers on one booking are enough for the group bookings team to process the refund.
stale: Group refunds are handled by the group bookings team. A group is a booking of 12 or more travelers. The group leader receives all refund payments.
current: Group refunds are handled by the group bookings team. A group is a booking of 9 or more travelers. The group leader receives all refund payments.

claim: The family room guarantee needs three children on the booking.
stale: Meridian offers a family room guarantee for bookings with two or more children. The guarantee covers resort partners only. Rooms are confirmed 14 days before arrival.
current: Meridian offers a family room guarantee for bookings with three or more children. The guarantee covers resort partners only. Rooms are confirmed 14 days before arrival.

claim: Meridian holds a lone traveler's seat on a rebooked flight once the delay passes 3 hours.
stale: Meridian holds a seat for a lone traveler on a rebooked flight if the delay exceeds 4 hours. The hold lasts until the next departure. Customers are notified by SMS.
current: Meridian holds a seat for a lone traveler on a rebooked flight if the delay exceeds 3 hours. The hold lasts until the next departure. Customers are notified by SMS.

claim: A 14-year-old may join an excursion rated challenging.
stale: Excursions rated challenging require guests to be at least 16 years old. Guests under 18 need a signed consent form. Helmets are supplied.
current: Excursions rated challenging require guests to be at least 14 years old. Guests under 18 need a signed consent form. Helmets are supplied.

claim: A single booking's lounge access add-on can cover as many as six travelers.
stale: Meridian's lounge access add-on is limited to groups of up to 4 travelers per booking. Extra guests pay at the door. Children under 2 enter free.
current: Meridian's lounge access add-on is limited to groups of up to 6 travelers per booking. Extra guests pay at the door. Children under 2 enter free.

claim: A package booking can be handed to another traveler if Meridian is told 5 days beforehand.
stale: Package holiday customers can transfer a booking to another person with 7 days' notice. The replacement traveler must meet the same fare conditions. A transfer fee of GBP 30 applies.
current: Package holiday customers can transfer a booking to another person with 5 days' notice. The replacement traveler must meet the same fare conditions. A transfer fee of GBP 30 applies.

claim: A booking for eight passengers is handled as a group booking.
stale: Meridian bookings made for more than 9 passengers are treated as group bookings. Group bookings need a deposit of 25% at confirmation. The balance is due 60 days before departure. Names may be supplied up to 30 days before departure. Individual passengers cannot be removed after the balance is paid.
current: Meridian bookings made for more than 7 passengers are treated as group bookings. Group bookings need a deposit of 25% at confirmation. The balance is due 60 days before departure. Names may be supplied up to 30 days before departure. Individual passengers cannot be removed after the balance is paid.

claim: Insured travelers from age 75 pay an age loading of 40% on the Cover Plus premium.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus offers cancellation cover for any insured traveler. Travelers aged 80 or over are charged an age loading on the premium. The loading is 40% of the base premium. Cover for pre-existing conditions is subject to a medical declaration. The policy runs from purchase until the return date.
current: Meridian Cover Plus offers cancellation cover for any insured traveler. Travelers aged 75 or over are charged an age loading on the premium. The loading is 40% of the base premium. Cover for pre-existing conditions is subject to a medical declaration. The policy runs from purchase until the return date.

claim: For tropical trips, Meridian advises seeing a doctor 8 weeks or more before leaving.
stale: Meridian health guidance for tropical destinations is shown at booking. Travelers should see a doctor at least 6 weeks before departure. Yellow fever certificates are checked at some borders. Pregnant travelers should seek advice before booking. Meridian cannot give medical advice.
current: Meridian health guidance for tropical destinations is shown at booking. Travelers should see a doctor at least 8 weeks before departure. Yellow fever certificates are checked at some borders. Pregnant travelers should seek advice before booking. Meridian cannot give medical advice.

claim: A 12-year-old on a scheduled flight pays the child fare of 75% of the adult price.
stale: Meridian child fares apply to passengers aged 2 to 11 on scheduled flights. Child fares are 75% of the adult fare. Infants under 2 pay 10% of the adult fare. Each adult may travel with up to two infants. Proof of age may be requested at check-in.
current: Meridian child fares apply to passengers aged 2 to 12 on scheduled flights. Child fares are 75% of the adult fare. Infants under 2 pay 10% of the adult fare. Each adult may travel with up to two infants. Proof of age may be requested at check-in.

claim: Meridian's visa desk takes applications up to 15 days before departure.
stale: Meridian offers visa assistance for all long-haul packages. Applications must be submitted at least 21 days before departure. Customers must provide a passport scan and a photo. Processing times depend on the embassy. Rush handling is not available.
current: Meridian offers visa assistance for all long-haul packages. Applications must be submitted at least 15 days before departure. Customers must provide a passport scan and a photo. Processing times depend on the embassy. Rush handling is not available.

claim: Pets cannot ride in the cabin on Meridian flights to Ireland.
stale: Meridian allows pets to travel in the cabin on flights to Ireland.
current: Meridian does not allow pets to travel in the cabin on flights to Ireland.

claim: A spelling mistake in a passenger name on a Saver fare can be fixed after booking.
stale: Name corrections are not permitted on Saver fares after booking.
current: Name corrections are permitted on Saver fares after booking.

claim: On Meridian charter flights, power banks have to stay out of checked baggage.
stale: Power banks may be packed in checked baggage on Meridian charter flights.
current: Power banks may not be packed in checked baggage on Meridian charter flights.

claim: A bereavement entitles a customer to a refund even on a non-refundable fare.
stale: Bereavement does not entitle a customer to a refund on a non-refundable fare.
current: Bereavement entitles a customer to a refund on a non-refundable fare.

claim: Excursions must be paid for before the day they take place.
stale: Guests may pay for excursions in cash on the day.
current: Guests may not pay for excursions on the day; payment must be made in advance.

claim: Cover Plus pays out for losses caused by volcanic ash.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus excludes losses caused by volcanic ash.
current: Meridian Cover Plus covers losses caused by volcanic ash.

claim: Customer relations does not take complaints by telephone.
stale: Meridian's customer relations team accepts complaints by telephone.
current: Meridian's customer relations team does not accept complaints by telephone.

claim: Guests on a package cannot swap hotels partway through the trip.
stale: Mid-trip changes to package hotels are permitted. Requests go through the resort team. Price differences are payable locally.
current: Mid-trip changes to package hotels are not permitted. Requests go through the resort team. Price differences are payable locally.

claim: Seat selection on a Flex fare carries a charge.
stale: Meridian Flex fares include free seat selection. Saver fares charge a fee. Upgrades are subject to availability.
current: Meridian Flex fares do not include free seat selection. Saver fares charge a fee. Upgrades are subject to availability.

claim: Package guests may not buy extra nights directly at the hotel.
stale: Travelers on Meridian packages may extend their stay by buying extra nights at the hotel. Extensions are subject to hotel availability. Return flights must be rebooked through Meridian.
current: Travelers on Meridian packages may not extend their stay by buying extra nights at the hotel. Extensions are subject to hotel availability. Return flights must be rebooked through Meridian.

claim: Visa-on-arrival fees at Meridian destination desks cannot be settled by card.
stale: Visa-on-arrival fees may be paid by card at the Meridian destination desks. Receipts are issued on the spot. Cash payments are accepted in local currency.
current: Visa-on-arrival fees may not be paid by card at the Meridian destination desks. Receipts are issued on the spot. Cash payments are accepted in local currency.

claim: Meridian wants a printed insurance certificate and refuses a screen copy.
stale: Meridian accepts a digital copy of the insurance certificate. The certificate must show the policy number. Claims require the original receipts.
current: Meridian does not accept a digital copy of the insurance certificate. The certificate must show the policy number. Claims require the original receipts.

claim: Codeshare passengers from partner airlines have to check in at the partner's own desk.
stale: Codeshare passengers of partner airlines may check in at Meridian desks. Desks open three hours before departure. Passengers must have valid documents.
current: Codeshare passengers of partner airlines may not check in at Meridian desks. Desks open three hours before departure. Passengers must have valid documents.

claim: Meridian rejects an excursion complaint that is filed for someone else.
stale: Complaints about excursions may be made on behalf of another guest. The complainant must provide the guest's booking reference. Replies go to the lead passenger.
current: Complaints about excursions may not be made on behalf of another guest. The complainant must provide the guest's booking reference. Replies go to the lead passenger.

claim: A baggage allowance left unused outbound is lost on the return leg.
stale: Unused baggage allowance can be carried over to the return flight. Allowance is shown on the booking page. Excess is charged at the airport.
current: Unused baggage allowance cannot be carried over to the return flight. Allowance is shown on the booking page. Excess is charged at the airport.

claim: A canceled package cannot be rebooked for a different destination.
stale: Meridian lets customers rebook a canceled package for a different destination. Rebooking is subject to availability. Price differences are payable at the time of rebooking. Rebooked trips must depart within 12 months. Loyalty points are kept on the booking.
current: Meridian does not let customers rebook a canceled package for a different destination. Rebooking is subject to availability. Price differences are payable at the time of rebooking. Rebooked trips must depart within 12 months. Loyalty points are kept on the booking.

claim: Prescription liquids over 100 ml are barred from cabin bags on Meridian charter flights.
stale: Meridian permits liquid medication above 100 ml in cabin baggage on its charter flights when accompanied by a prescription. Customers should keep medication in its original packaging. Security staff may ask to inspect it. Medication needed in flight should be packed in the cabin. A doctor's letter is recommended.
current: Meridian does not permit liquid medication above 100 ml in cabin baggage on its charter flights when accompanied by a prescription. Customers should keep medication in its original packaging. Security staff may ask to inspect it. Medication needed in flight should be packed in the cabin. A doctor's letter is recommended.

claim: A guest who cancels an excursion after departure gets a credit.
stale: Meridian does not allow guests to cancel excursions after departure for a credit. Credits are valid for use on future excursions. Credits are shown in the customer account. Credits cannot be exchanged for cash. Credits may be shared with the lead passenger's household.
current: Meridian allows guests to cancel excursions after departure for a credit. Credits are valid for use on future excursions. Credits are shown in the customer account. Credits cannot be exchanged for cash. Credits may be shared with the lead passenger's household.

claim: A 17-year-old cannot make a Meridian booking alone.
stale: Travelers aged 16 and 17 may make a booking on their own. Lead passengers must provide a valid email address. Payment must be made by a card in the lead passenger's name. Confirmation is sent immediately. Meridian may ask for ID at check-in.
current: Travelers aged 16 and 17 may not make a booking on their own. Lead passengers must provide a valid email address. Payment must be made by a card in the lead passenger's name. Confirmation is sent immediately. Meridian may ask for ID at check-in.

claim: Meridian guests at partner hotels cannot check in before noon.
stale: Partner hotels permit Meridian guests to check in before noon. Standard check-in begins at 3 pm. Guests may store luggage at reception. Late arrivals should call the front desk. Keys are issued at reception.
current: Partner hotels do not permit Meridian guests to check in before noon. Standard check-in begins at 3 pm. Guests may store luggage at reception. Late arrivals should call the front desk. Keys are issued at reception.

claim: A full excursion refund requires the guest to cancel through the portal.
stale: Meridian refunds a canceled excursion in full.
current: Meridian refunds a canceled excursion in full if the cancellation is made through the portal.

claim: Long-haul check-in with Meridian involves an online health declaration along with a passport.
stale: Check-in on Meridian long-haul flights requires a valid passport.
current: Check-in on Meridian long-haul flights requires a valid passport and a completed online health declaration.

claim: Moving a Wallet balance to a bank account requires the customer to pass identity verification.
stale: A Meridian Wallet balance can be refunded to a bank account.
current: A Meridian Wallet balance can be refunded to a bank account after identity verification.

claim: A cancellation for illness under Cover Plus has to be backed by a doctor's note.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus pays for cancellation due to illness.
current: Meridian Cover Plus pays for cancellation due to illness confirmed by a doctor's note.

claim: On Flex fares seat selection costs nothing, whenever the booking was made.
stale: Seat selection is free on Flex fares booked at least 7 days before departure.
current: Seat selection is free on Flex fares.

claim: Travelers over 70 are not charged for a paper ticket.
stale: Meridian charges a fee of GBP 20 for a paper ticket.
current: Meridian charges a fee of GBP 20 for a paper ticket unless the traveler is over 70.

claim: A group leader travels at no charge however small the group is.
stale: Group leaders travel free on group bookings with at least 15 paying travelers.
current: Group leaders travel free on every group booking.

claim: The change fee on Flex fares is waived for requests made at least 48 hours ahead of departure.
stale: Meridian waives the change fee on Flex fares. The waiver applies to date changes. Name changes carry a fee.
current: Meridian waives the change fee on Flex fares when the change is requested at least 48 hours before departure. The waiver applies to date changes. Name changes carry a fee.

claim: Unused hotel nights are refunded only if the customer tells Meridian before the first of them.
stale: Customers receive a refund for unused hotel nights. The refund is paid within 14 days. Taxes are not refunded.
current: Customers receive a refund for unused hotel nights if Meridian is told before the first unused night. The refund is paid within 14 days. Taxes are not refunded.

claim: At Alpine resorts, ski insurance is compulsory for guests who rent equipment through Meridian partners.
stale: Alpine resort guests must hold ski insurance. Meridian sells it at booking. The premium is GBP 18 per person.
current: Alpine resort guests must hold ski insurance when they hire equipment from Meridian partners. Meridian sells it at booking. The premium is GBP 18 per person.

claim: A deposit paid within a week of the activity can be recovered with a doctor's note.
stale: Meridian requires a deposit for excursion bookings. Deposits are non-refundable within 7 days of the activity. Balances are paid on the day.
current: Meridian requires a deposit for excursion bookings. Deposits are non-refundable within 7 days of the activity unless a doctor's note is provided. Balances are paid on the day.

claim: Gold members reissue a lost boarding pass for free.
stale: Meridian charges GBP 25 to reissue a lost boarding pass. Reissues are available at the airport desk. Passengers must show photo ID.
current: Meridian charges GBP 25 to reissue a lost boarding pass, except for Gold members. Reissues are available at the airport desk. Passengers must show photo ID.

claim: One free amendment to a package booking is available however close departure is.
stale: Meridian permits one free amendment to a package booking if departure is more than 30 days away. Further amendments cost GBP 30 each. Amendments must be requested through the portal.
current: Meridian permits one free amendment to a package booking. Further amendments cost GBP 30 each. Amendments must be requested through the portal.

claim: Visa help from Meridian is limited to travelers with two blank pages in their passport.
stale: Meridian visa assistance covers tourist visas. Business visas are handled by a separate team. Fees depend on destination.
current: Meridian visa assistance covers tourist visas for travelers whose passports have two blank pages. Business visas are handled by a separate team. Fees depend on destination.

claim: Guests whose excursion is stopped by weather get a refund only if no rebooking was offered.
stale: Guests receive a refund when weather stops an excursion. The operator decides whether weather is severe. Refunds are issued automatically.
current: Guests receive a refund when weather stops an excursion and the operator has not offered a rebooking. The operator decides whether weather is severe. Refunds are issued automatically.

claim: A document-loss claim above GBP 300 needs a police report even when nothing was stolen.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus covers the loss of travel documents. The policy pays for emergency replacement passports. Cover is limited to GBP 600 per trip. A police report is required for theft claims. Claims must be filed within 30 days.
current: Meridian Cover Plus covers the loss of travel documents. The policy pays for emergency replacement passports. Cover is limited to GBP 600 per trip. A police report is required for theft claims and for losses over GBP 300. Claims must be filed within 30 days.

claim: A Gold member on a Saver fare pays nothing for checked baggage.
stale: Meridian charges for checked baggage on Saver fares. The charge is GBP 22 per bag online. Airport rates are higher. Bags must be paid for before check-in closes. Flex fares include one bag.
current: Meridian charges for checked baggage on Saver fares, except for Gold members. The charge is GBP 22 per bag online. Airport rates are higher. Bags must be paid for before check-in closes. Flex fares include one bag.

claim: Travelers to the Delta Coast region with a medical exemption letter may board without a vaccination record.
stale: Travelers to the Delta Coast region must carry a vaccination record. Meridian checks records at check-in. Travelers who cannot show one are refused boarding. Records can be paper or digital. Meridian's health desk can advise.
current: Travelers to the Delta Coast region must carry a vaccination record unless they hold a medical exemption letter. Meridian checks records at check-in. Travelers who cannot show one are refused boarding. Records can be paper or digital. Meridian's health desk can advise.

claim: Where a resort has no representative on site, customer relations takes package holiday complaints straight away.
stale: Complaints about a Meridian package holiday must be reported to the resort team during the stay. Unresolved complaints may be escalated to customer relations. Escalations need the booking reference. Customer relations replies in writing. Compensation is assessed case by case.
current: Complaints about a Meridian package holiday must be reported to the resort team during the stay unless the resort has no representative on site, in which case customer relations accepts them directly. Unresolved complaints may be escalated to customer relations. Escalations need the booking reference. Customer relations replies in writing. Compensation is assessed case by case.

claim: Meridian charges no handling fee for refunding airport taxes on an unused ticket.
stale: Meridian refunds airport taxes on unused tickets for a fee of GBP 15. Refunds are processed with the next billing cycle. A refund request form is available in the portal. Fees may apply to group tickets. Taxes on partially used tickets are not refundable.
current: Meridian refunds airport taxes on unused tickets free of charge. Refunds are processed with the next billing cycle. A refund request form is available in the portal. Fees may apply to group tickets. Taxes on partially used tickets are not refundable.

claim: Cover Plus winter sports cover extends to Nordic resorts.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus covers winter sports in the Alpine region.
current: Meridian Cover Plus covers winter sports in the Alpine and Nordic regions.

claim: City packages as well as Sun packages carry the child price.
stale: The Meridian child price applies to all Sun packages.
current: The Meridian child price applies to all Sun and City packages.

claim: Free cancellation on Flex fares covers every Meridian route, not just flights to the Atlantic Isles.
stale: Free cancellation applies to Flex fares on flights to the Atlantic Isles only.
current: Free cancellation applies to Flex fares on all Meridian routes.

claim: Flight-only customers can use Meridian's 24-hour assistance line.
stale: Meridian's 24-hour assistance line serves customers on package holidays.
current: Meridian's 24-hour assistance line serves customers on package holidays and flight-only bookings.

claim: Passengers on scheduled flights can check in online with Meridian.
stale: Online check-in is available on Meridian charter flights.
current: Online check-in is available on Meridian charter and scheduled flights.

claim: Irish passport holders may use Meridian's visa assistance.
stale: Meridian visa assistance is offered to UK passport holders.
current: Meridian visa assistance is offered to UK and Irish passport holders.

claim: Gold lounge access is valid in Madrid as well as Lisbon.
stale: Lounge access is included with Meridian Gold status. It applies at partner lounges in Lisbon only. Guests are limited to one companion.
current: Lounge access is included with Meridian Gold status. It applies at partner lounges in Lisbon and Madrid. Guests are limited to one companion.

claim: Delayed baggage on return flights qualifies for the essentials allowance.
stale: The baggage delay allowance covers essentials up to GBP 100. It applies to outbound flights only. Receipts must be kept.
current: The baggage delay allowance covers essentials up to GBP 100. It applies to outbound and return flights. Receipts must be kept.

claim: Meridian's price-match promise includes package holidays to Greece.
stale: Meridian's price-match promise covers package holidays to Spain. Requests need a link to the competing offer. Matches are made within 2 working days.
current: Meridian's price-match promise covers package holidays to Spain and Greece. Requests need a link to the competing offer. Matches are made within 2 working days.

claim: Hiking tours as well as boat trips are refundable when weather stops them.
stale: Excursion refunds for weather apply to boat trips. Operators decide within one hour of departure. Refunds are paid to the original card.
current: Excursion refunds for weather apply to boat trips and hiking tours. Operators decide within one hour of departure. Refunds are paid to the original card.

claim: Wallet credit can pay for UK excursions.
stale: The Meridian Wallet can be used for packages booked in the UK. Wallet credit expires after 12 months. Top-ups start at GBP 10.
current: The Meridian Wallet can be used for packages and excursions booked in the UK. Wallet credit expires after 12 months. Top-ups start at GBP 10.

claim: Northwind Air takes Meridian Flex fares on European routes too.
stale: Northwind Air accepts Meridian Flex fares on domestic routes. Fare conditions follow Meridian's rules. Baggage rules follow Northwind Air's.
current: Northwind Air accepts Meridian Flex fares on domestic and European routes. Fare conditions follow Meridian's rules. Baggage rules follow Northwind Air's.

claim: Customers living in Ireland get the free cancellation window for UK residents.
stale: The free cancellation window applies to bookings made by customers resident in the UK. Residents of other countries follow the standard window. Proof of residence may be requested.
current: The free cancellation window applies to bookings made by customers resident in the UK or Ireland. Residents of other countries follow the standard window. Proof of residence may be requested.

claim: Cover Plus is valid for trips to the Caribbean.
stale: Meridian Cover Plus is valid for trips to Europe. Trips outside Europe need Cover Global. Both policies start at departure.
current: Meridian Cover Plus is valid for trips to Europe and the Caribbean. Trips outside Europe need Cover Global. Both policies start at departure.

claim: Customers can speak Portuguese as well as Spanish to the complaints team on weekdays.
stale: Complaints support in Spanish is offered on weekdays. Other languages are handled by email. Replies take up to 5 working days.
current: Complaints support in Spanish and Portuguese is offered on weekdays. Other languages are handled by email. Replies take up to 5 working days.

claim: The rebooking guarantee for missed connections covers partner airline flights.
stale: Meridian's rebooking guarantee protects package customers if a connecting flight is missed. Meridian arranges the next available flight at no cost. The guarantee covers flights operated by Meridian only. Hotel nights are covered for up to two nights. Customers must contact the airport desk before leaving the terminal.
current: Meridian's rebooking guarantee protects package customers if a connecting flight is missed. Meridian arranges the next available flight at no cost. The guarantee covers flights operated by Meridian and its partner airlines. Hotel nights are covered for up to two nights. Customers must contact the airport desk before leaving the terminal.

claim: Meridian traces delayed bags from every UK airport, not only London ones.
stale: Meridian traces delayed baggage on flights departing from London airports. Customers file a report at the baggage desk. A reference number is issued on the spot. Updates are sent by SMS. Delivery to the hotel is free.
current: Meridian traces delayed baggage on flights departing from any UK airport. Customers file a report at the baggage desk. A reference number is issued on the spot. Updates are sent by SMS. Delivery to the hotel is free.

claim: Proof of a malaria prevention course is also demanded for Coastal Plain trips.
stale: Travelers to Highland Lake destinations must show proof of a malaria prevention course. Doctors' letters are accepted. Meridian checks documents at check-in. Children under 5 are exempt. Travelers who cannot show proof are refused boarding.
current: Travelers to Highland Lake and Coastal Plain destinations must show proof of a malaria prevention course. Doctors' letters are accepted. Meridian checks documents at check-in. Children under 5 are exempt. Travelers who cannot show proof are refused boarding.

claim: A traveling companion of the lead passenger also receives the 8% senior discount.
stale: Meridian's senior discount applies to package holidays booked by travelers aged 60 or over. The discount is 8% of the package price. It cannot be combined with other offers. It applies to the lead passenger only. Proof of age is needed at booking.
current: Meridian's senior discount applies to package holidays booked by travelers aged 60 or over. The discount is 8% of the package price. It cannot be combined with other offers. It applies to the lead passenger and one companion. Proof of age is needed at booking.

claim: Water sports excursions come with Meridian's excursion insurance.
stale: Excursion insurance is included with every excursion except water sports. It covers medical costs up to GBP 5,000. Claims are handled by Meridian's insurer. Cover applies to guests aged 18 or over. Guests under 18 must be covered by a parent's policy.
current: Excursion insurance is included with every excursion including water sports. It covers medical costs up to GBP 5,000. Claims are handled by Meridian's insurer. Cover applies to guests aged 18 or over. Guests under 18 must be covered by a parent's policy.

claim: Online check-in stays open until one hour before departure.
stale: Online check-in for Meridian flights closes 2 hours before departure.
current: Online check-in for Meridian flights closes 1 hour before departure.

claim: A refund request for a canceled excursion can be filed up to 60 days afterwards.
stale: Refund requests for canceled excursions must be filed within 30 days.
current: Refund requests for canceled excursions must be filed within 60 days.

claim: Customers get 14 days after arrival to report damaged baggage.
stale: Baggage damage must be reported within 7 days of arrival.
current: Baggage damage must be reported within 14 days of arrival.

claim: The balance on a package falls due 8 weeks ahead of departure.
stale: Package balances are due 10 weeks before departure.
current: Package balances are due 8 weeks before departure.

claim: A complaint can be lodged up to 90 days after a trip ends.
stale: Complaints must be submitted within 28 days of the end of the trip.
current: Complaints must be submitted within 90 days of the end of the trip.

claim: Customers have 30 days after coming home to file a Cover Plus claim.
stale: Cover Plus claims must be filed within 14 days of returning home.
current: Cover Plus claims must be filed within 30 days of returning home.

claim: A transfer canceled 48 hours before pickup is refunded in full.
stale: Airport transfers can be canceled free of charge until 24 hours before pickup. Later cancellations are not refunded. Cancellations are made in the portal.
current: Airport transfers can be canceled free of charge until 48 hours before pickup. Later cancellations are not refunded. Cancellations are made in the portal.

claim: Saver fare passengers can pick seats from 24 hours before the flight.
stale: Seat selection for Saver fares opens 48 hours before departure. Flex fares can select seats at booking. Selected seats are shown on the boarding pass.
current: Seat selection for Saver fares opens 24 hours before departure. Flex fares can select seats at booking. Selected seats are shown on the boarding pass.

claim: A traveler's name on a package can be swapped as late as 7 days before departure.
stale: Name changes on package bookings must be requested at least 14 days before departure. A fee of GBP 30 applies. Changes are confirmed by email.
current: Name changes on package bookings must be requested at least 7 days before departure. A fee of GBP 30 applies. Changes are confirmed by email.

claim: Card refunds are paid within 7 working days.
stale: Meridian processes card refunds within 14 working days. Wallet refunds are faster. Customers are notified by email.
current: Meridian processes card refunds within 7 working days. Wallet refunds are faster. Customers are notified by email.

claim: Check-in for charter flights shuts 45 minutes before departure.
stale: Check-in desks for charter flights close 60 minutes before departure. Bags handed in after that time are not accepted. Hand baggage can be taken to the gate.
current: Check-in desks for charter flights close 45 minutes before departure. Bags handed in after that time are not accepted. Hand baggage can be taken to the gate.

claim: A package booking can be canceled free of charge only within 24 hours of booking.
stale: Free cancellation of package holidays is available for 72 hours after booking. After that, the standard charges apply. Cancellation requests are made by phone.
current: Free cancellation of package holidays is available for 24 hours after booking. After that, the standard charges apply. Cancellation requests are made by phone.

claim: Visa applications reach Meridian in time if sent 15 working days before departure.
stale: Visa applications handled by Meridian must be submitted at least 25 working days before departure. Late applications carry a rush fee. The visa desk confirms receipt.
current: Visa applications handled by Meridian must be submitted at least 15 working days before departure. Late applications carry a rush fee. The visa desk confirms receipt.

claim: Meridian wants two weeks of notice for a passenger who needs oxygen on board.
stale: Travelers must tell Meridian about medical conditions requiring oxygen at least 21 days before travel. Meridian then arranges approval with the airline. Approval is confirmed by email.
current: Travelers must tell Meridian about medical conditions requiring oxygen at least 14 days before travel. Meridian then arranges approval with the airline. Approval is confirmed by email.

claim: Bookings for next-day excursions are accepted until 8 pm.
stale: Excursion bookings for the following day close at 6 pm. Bookings after the cut-off go to a waiting list. Confirmations are sent by SMS.
current: Excursion bookings for the following day close at 8 pm. Bookings after the cut-off go to a waiting list. Confirmations are sent by SMS.

claim: After returning early for medical reasons, a guest has 45 days to request a refund for unused package time.
stale: Meridian refunds the unused portion of a package holiday if a guest returns early for medical reasons. The refund request must be filed within 30 days of the return date. A doctor's letter is required. Refunds are paid in the original currency. Hotel nights already consumed are not refunded.
current: Meridian refunds the unused portion of a package holiday if a guest returns early for medical reasons. The refund request must be filed within 45 days of the return date. A doctor's letter is required. Refunds are paid in the original currency. Hotel nights already consumed are not refunded.

claim: Bag drop on Meridian charter departures shuts 75 minutes before takeoff.
stale: Meridian passengers must arrive at the airport at least 3 hours before charter departures. Check-in desks open 4 hours before. Bag drop closes 60 minutes before departure. Passengers with special assistance should arrive 30 minutes earlier. Gates close 20 minutes before departure.
current: Meridian passengers must arrive at the airport at least 3 hours before charter departures. Check-in desks open 4 hours before. Bag drop closes 75 minutes before departure. Passengers with special assistance should arrive 30 minutes earlier. Gates close 20 minutes before departure.

claim: The cooling-off period for Cover Plus premiums lasts 30 days from purchase.
stale: Insurance premiums on Cover Plus can be refunded if the policy is canceled in the cooling-off period. The cooling-off period lasts 14 days from purchase. No claims may have been made. Refunds are paid within 10 days. Cover ends on cancellation.
current: Insurance premiums on Cover Plus can be refunded if the policy is canceled in the cooling-off period. The cooling-off period lasts 30 days from purchase. No claims may have been made. Refunds are paid within 10 days. Cover ends on cancellation.

claim: Return flight times must be confirmed 48 hours before departure.
stale: Meridian asks customers to confirm return flight times 72 hours before departure. Confirmation is available in the app. Customers who do not confirm may lose their seat on partner airline flights. Reminders are sent by email. Time changes are posted on the booking page.
current: Meridian asks customers to confirm return flight times 48 hours before departure. Confirmation is available in the app. Customers who do not confirm may lose their seat on partner airline flights. Reminders are sent by email. Time changes are posted on the booking page.

claim: Meridian pays the refund for a flight it canceled within 7 days.
stale: Refunds for flights canceled by Meridian are paid automatically. The refund is paid within 14 days of the cancellation. Customers can instead choose a rebooking. Vouchers are valid for 12 months. Taxes are always refunded.
current: Refunds for flights canceled by Meridian are paid automatically. The refund is paid within 7 days of the cancellation. Customers can instead choose a rebooking. Vouchers are valid for 12 months. Taxes are always refunded.
